subject: Beckham, Rapinoe, Altidore and Ertz voted into the National Soccer Hall of Fame
title: Beckham and Rapinoe enter the Hall

lines.vo: Who gets into the Hall of Fame first time? Megan Rapinoe.
lines.footage: Rapinoe Hall of Fame reaction clip

lines.vo: The National Soccer Hall of Fame just added four names. David Beckham is one of them.
Rapinoe has two Women's World Cups and the 2019 Ballon d'Or. The voters had an easy shift.
Jozy Altidore scored forty-two goals for his country. Nobody argued with the maths. Julie Ertz joins him on the player ballot.
Beckham came through the veteran ballot. Six Premier League titles, and he still used the side door.
lines.footage: Beckham Man United Premier League celebration

lines.vo: Rapinoe, front door. Beckham, side door. The ceremony is on April sixteenth in Plano, Texas. Wear the good suit, Becks.
Want the next story before it breaks? Betting tips, news and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: A caricature of a cartoon footballer with short bright hair walks through a grand front door of a glittering hall. Gag: she carries a golden ball trophy and tips her hat. Twist: the door closes behind her and a red carpet unrolls ahead.

A caricature of a cartoon midfielder with a swept hairstyle tiptoes through a side door of the same hall. Gag: he straightens his tie at the last second. Twist: the side door opens into the same golden hall and he beams.
